title: Chapter 175
text:
On the other side of the forbidden zone, Han Xiao had arrived at his destination. The air was filled with an unpleasant stench of rot and slight toxins. The plants on the ground were all deformed.

"The range is a bit big. I don't know the location of the Boss Beast King."

Han Xiao put down the metal box in his hand and opened it. He quickly put on the modified Viper mech and observed the outside world through the holographic screen. Usually, it was the same as normal vision and could be zoomed in and out at any time. There were also various scanning modules on the screen, giving him a more detailed understanding of his surroundings. There was also a radar on the top left corner of the screen. The small radar could detect life signals within a kilometer in diameter and could reach up to three kilometers in power.

The scanning and analysis module could analyze the traces on the ground and analyze what creatures had passed by a certain period of time. It could also analyze and record some unknown things and record them into the database.

The filter made the rotten air fresh. Han Xiao could hear his own breathing. The thermostat of the mech made him very comfortable and not stuffy at all.

He carried firearms and some grenades, which were all fixed to the rails of the mech. Fully armed, they did not affect his movements.

Han Xiao moved his arms and legs and familiarized himself with the controls of the mech. With a spring of his legs, he jumped nearly ten meters and entered the forbidden zone.

He was now in standby mode. The Bonfire Reaction Furnace recovered more energy than it consumed, so it was always at full power.

The radar was always on. As long as there was a strong life signal, it could be the Beast King. Because the Beast King was not fixed every time, Han Xiao was not sure what species it was.

After running for five minutes, more than ten life signals appeared. Han Xiao used the password to adjust the zoom in and out of his vision. The scanning mirror in his eyes was enlarged like a sniper scope. The current control mode did not have a neural link, so he needed to use language to control various functions. The smart chip could analyze such simple commands, and Han Xiao also set up voice recognition. It could only recognize his voice and use it as a command, others could not use it.

A few hundred meters away, more than ten giraffe-like beasts were resting. The ferocious bone spurs on their bodies showed that they were not docile at all. A few of the largest giraffes raised their heads and looked in his direction. They seemed to have discovered him.

"Stealth mode."

The optical camouflage was activated. The surface of the mech became the color of the surrounding environment. It was like a chameleon. At first glance, it was impossible to find anything unusual. The gaps of the mech were sealed, so not a trace of smell leaked out.

The giraffes shook their heads, but they didn't find him, so they lay down again.

Enemies with high enough levels would be able to see through his concealment, but this group of wild beasts was still far from it. Han Xiao continued to move forward, searching for his target.

Two hours later, he had scanned dozens of mutated animals and plants and recorded them into the database. He also fought a few wild beasts with different signal strengths to enrich the data and determine the approximate level of each signal strength.

The highest level wild beasts he had encountered so far were a group of Level 42 wolf-like mastiffs. They were not the target he was looking for.

The sky darkened. The forbidden zone was even more dangerous at night. All kinds of beast howls could be heard from different directions.

Without a Mech, the night in the Forbidden Zone was indeed very dangerous. However, the night could increase Viper's concealment ability and seal off his own scent and sound. He was like a rock, inconspicuous.

"I haven't found the target yet." Han Xiao leaned against a huge rock and loaded yellow bullets into the magazine. His field of vision was changed to night vision. The database had recorded the areas he had been to. The possibility of the Beast King entrenched in the center of the forbidden zone was higher. That was the Ruins of La Pert. The closer he was to the center of the forbidden zone, the more likely he would encounter wild beasts.

Han Xiao gave a command. The leg armor on his calf suddenly opened up. There was a small space inside which stored some mini Spider Detectors. Han Xiao activated the Spider Detectors and had them disperse to the center. Everything they saw would be reflected in his field of vision.

The Spider Detectors shook their heads and left at a fast speed. After a while, Han Xiao also saw the situation in the center through the Spider Detectors' cameras. He saw many ferocious wild beasts passing by.

Suddenly, the image reflected by Spider No.1 shook slightly. There was also the sound of violent collisions from afar. He saw that the wild beasts were gathering in a certain direction.

Spider No.1 climbed onto the back of a boar and followed them. The image showed two Supers being chased by all kinds of wild beasts. One of them was an Esper who could release white shockwaves with his hands. The shockwaves were quite powerful, and they repelled the wild beasts that approached them time and time again. However, the sound it made attracted more wild beasts. It was a vicious cycle.

"There are others in the forbidden zone?" Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. The next moment, he saw a five-meter-tall, ten-meter-long giant white lion appear. Wherever it passed, the other beasts avoided it in fear. Those that did not avoid it were bitten to death by this giant white lion, crushing a path through the crowd of beasts.

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled. This was most likely the Beast King.

…

Yang Dian and Ned were running for their lives. They were out of breath, and their lungs were burning. Behind them were hundreds of mutated beasts and a giant white lion whose aura was so terrifying that they couldn't even muster up the will to fight.

"It's all because of your Esper ability. The sound attracted the wild beasts," Yang Dian said angrily.

Ned slapped his palm backward, and a white shockwave spread out, pushing back the approaching beasts again. Hearing that, he said angrily, "Shut up! If it weren't for your carelessness, we could've sneaked past that pack of wolves. Stop talking nonsense. What should we do now?"

Yang Dian took out his tablet to browse the map while running. "We are approaching the center of the forbidden zone. It's very dangerous. Quickly change directions!"

The two of them quickly changed directions. The wild beasts were chasing them, and the giant white lion was the closest to them. Ned's shockwaves could only stop it for a moment. It could not even make the white lion retreat. Ned was sweating profusely, and his energy was running out.

This time, a broken wall suddenly appeared in front of them. There was a crack at the bottom that was just big enough for a human to roll in.

The two of them were overjoyed.

"Hide in there!"

Suddenly, Ned realized that a giant shadow was rapidly expanding under his feet. He turned around in shock. The white lion jumped into the air and slapped down with its giant claws. The wind was so strong that Ned could not even open his eyes. The pressure almost suffocated him.

"You go first!" Yang Dian yelled. He pushed Ned away and threw a punch at the incoming claw. Thick blue flames wrapped around his arm.

He was a Martial Artist. His body was strong, and he could take more hits than Ned. He thought that it should not be a problem for him to block this attack.

The fist and the claw crashed into each other.

A series of cracking sounds were heard. Yang Dian's arm was fractured, and a few of his ribs were also broken by the shockwaves. He spat out a mouthful of blood and flew dozens of meters away like a small stone. He plowed a hole in the ground, and blood flowed out of his mouth and nose.

Ned hurriedly pulled him into the crack. The claw that followed dug into the crack, and rocks flew everywhere. The two of them almost could not escape.

"Such terrifying strength!" Yang Dian was in so much pain that his face twitched. He, a powerful Martial Artist, was severely injured by a single attack. This lion's strength was shocking.

Ned was even more shocked. He knew how strong his companion was, but he could not even take a single hit from the white lion.

This time, they were doomed.

Surrounded by wild beasts, the two of them had no choice but to rely on the crack to survive. They would die if they stuck their heads out.

The wild beasts could not squeeze in. They dug into the crack with their claws, trying to dig a bigger hole. The sounds of collisions made the two of them shudder.

Yang Dian took out bandages and ointment to treat his wounds. They might have to fight to the death next, so he could only endure the pain and recover. Beside him, Ned was also using all his strength to recover.
